title: fix: preserve apparmor detection during restart cleanup
body:
On AppArmor-enabled hosts, rootful containers with explicit UID/GID mappings enter the createRootlessContainer path with hideFiles=true. This creates a temporary mount namespace and unmounts /sys/kernel/* to prevent kernel files from being bind-mounted inside the container. However, conmon and the cleanup process inherit this mount namespace, so /sys/kernel/security/apparmor becomes unavailable during automatic restart. This causes AppArmor detection to fail with "profile ... specified but AppArmor is disabled on the host", preventing container restart.

The fix preserves /sys/kernel/security mounts during the /sys/kernel unmount operation. This is safe because:
- The preserved mount is only visible to conmon and the cleanup process, not the container workload
- The container gets its own isolated mount namespace from runc/libcontainer
- The mount is slave-mounted (MS_SLAVE), so modifications don't propagate
- The cleanup process needs access to host AppArmor state to function correctly

Fixes: #29925
